violations.description: _REPO_ROOT used parents[2] instead of parents[3]; bridge could not locate vendor path
syllabify() returns list[dict] with plain dict phonological slots. Phone class is not a frozen dataclass. No SlotState, no SlotGraph, no EvidenceContract, no RankLattice rank assigned.
violations.remediation: Define PhonologicalSlot frozen dataclass aligned with taaqqul_slot_geometry Slot interface

violations.description: ROOT_CLAIM is carried in HokomLinguisticClaimBundle.root_claim but is not projected into any SlotGraph slot. Root attestation is not gate-governed.
violations.remediation: Add ROOT_CLAIM slot to _build_slot_graph() with evidence from root_claim field

violations.description: PATTERN_CLAIM (wazn_claim / form_claim) is not projected into any SlotGraph slot.
violations.remediation: Add PATTERN_CLAIM slot to _build_slot_graph() with evidence from wazn_claim/form_claim

violations.description: BAB_CLAIM (verb stem class / conjugation bab) is not projected into any SlotGraph slot.
MASDAR_CLAIM is carried in bundle.masdar_claim but is not projected into any SlotGraph slot.
violations.remediation: Add MASDAR_CLAIM slot to _build_slot_graph() with evidence from masdar_claim

violations.description: DERIVATIVE_CLAIM (mushtaq_claims) is not projected into any SlotGraph slot.
violations.remediation: Add DERIVATIVE_CLAIM slots (one per mushtaq) to _build_slot_graph()

violations.description: All 8 SLOT_TRANS entries are raw dict transitions. _gate(state) returns plain strings. No TransitionGate.decide(), no EvidenceContract, no RankLattice, no DomainTransitionLicense, no TraceLedger entry for any phonological slot transition.
violations.remediation: Route each SLOT_TRANS entry through TransitionGate.decide() with phonological EvidenceContract

violations.description: Bridge builds at most 2 slots (domain_claim + optional word_class_claim). Conditions, obstacles, defeaters, and candidate_set fields of SlotGraph are never populated. Full Taaqol expressivity is unused.
violations.remediation: Populate conditions, obstacles, defeaters, candidate_set as appropriate for each claim type

violations.description: SlotState has no AMBIGUOUS value. When Hokom produces ambiguous morphological analysis, the bridge collapses to a single parse path silently. No AMBIGUOUS slot is opened, no candidate_set is populated.
violations.remediation: Use parallel BROKEN+FILLED slots with competing evidence contracts, or populate candidate_set

violations.description: claim_id = f'hokom:{token_id or uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}:{surface}' — uuid4() is non-deterministic. HokomClaimProjection docstring claims 'deterministic from content hash' but actual implementation uses random UUID. Not reproducible across runs.
violations.remediation: Replace uuid4() with SHA-256 hash of deterministic input fields (normalized_surface + lexical_class + domain_directive + ...)

violations.description: HokomTaaqolTraceEvent.output is declared as str (opaque string). Gamma ClosureState and TransitionGate TransitionVerdict are embedded as string representations, not structured fields. Does not mirror vendor TraceLedger PR-6 split (consulted_gamma_state vs gate_transition_state).
violations.remediation: Split output into gamma_state: Optional[str] and gate_verdict: Optional[str]; mirror PR-6 split

violations.description: HokomTaaqolDecision has to_dict() via dataclasses.asdict() but no from_dict() classmethod. No round-trip test. Serialization contract is one-way only.
violations.remediation: Add from_dict() classmethod and a round-trip test: assert Decision.from_dict(d.to_dict()) == d

violations.description: HokomTaaqolDecision.residuals is typed as bare 'tuple' (not tuple[HokomTaaqolResidual, ...]). Bridge populates it with plain strings. HokomTaaqolResidual frozen dataclass exists but is not used in the decision output.
violations.remediation: Type as tuple[HokomTaaqolResidual, ...] and populate bridge with typed HokomTaaqolResidual instances
